statement: For every 99-by-99 symmetric binary zero-diagonal matrix A with exactly 14 ones in each integer row, put r_uv=(A^2)_uv+A_uv-2 for u<v and let F3 count all unordered residuals not divisible by 3. Then F3 is not 6. This statement alone does not exclude any other positive value or establish the existence or nonexistence of the target; no remaining value is asserted realizable.

scope.description: Universal necessary exclusion of the single ternary residual count F3=6 in the complete simple symmetric zero-diagonal degree14 adjacency domain of order99. Identities and all six-edge support cases are reproduced without any prior theorem, lambda1, incidence, fixed graph or symmetry premise.

assumptions: A has order99, symmetric binary entries and zero diagonal.
Every integer row has exactly14 ones; complete common-neighbor and residual rows are used.
F3 counts all4851 unordered pairs with identical endpoint residues.
